headline_marked: 2 Bangladeshis killed, 24 injured in [[attack on Riyadh airport]]
headline: 2 Bangladeshis killed, 24 injured in attack on Riyadh airport
summary: The casualties occurred during a strike by the Iran-backed Houthi armed group at King Khalid International Airport in Saudi Arabia.
details: Two Bangladeshi nationals were killed and 24 others were injured in an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
The strike was carried out by the Iran-backed Houthi armed group from Yemen.
Authorities have identified the identities of the deceased and the injured Bangladeshis.
The attack follows a separate Houthi strike that reportedly killed 13 people a day prior.
The incident has caused significant casualties among the Bangladeshi expatriate community in the city.
caption:
2 Bangladeshis killed and 24 injured in a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport.

Two Bangladeshi nationals were killed and 24 others were injured in an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

The strike was carried out by the Iran-backed Houthi armed group from Yemen.

Authorities have identified the identities of the deceased and the injured Bangladeshis.

The attack follows a separate Houthi strike that reportedly killed 13 people a day prior.

The incident has caused significant casualties among the Bangladeshi expatriate community in the city.

headline_marked: Two [[retired army officers arrested]] in Dhaka
headline: Two retired army officers arrested in Dhaka
summary: Lieutenant Colonel (retired) Gulshan Ara and Lieutenant Colonel (retired) Debashish Biswas were detained by the Detective Branch of police.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of police has arrested two retired army officers with the rank of lieutenant colonel in Dhaka.
The arrested individuals are Lieutenant Colonel (retired) Gulshan Ara and Lieutenant Colonel (retired) Debashish Biswas.
According to Dhaka Metropolitan Police Additional Commissioner and DB chief Shafiqul Islam, the arrests took place on Sunday night.
A DB official stated that the arrests followed the discovery of evidence linking them to a suspect in a case under the Anti-Terrorism Act and the Cyber Security Act.
caption:
Two retired lieutenant colonels arrested in Dhaka.

The Detective Branch (DB) of police has arrested two retired army officers with the rank of lieutenant colonel in Dhaka.

The arrested individuals are Lieutenant Colonel (retired) Gulshan Ara and Lieutenant Colonel (retired) Debashish Biswas.

According to Dhaka Metropolitan Police Additional Commissioner and DB chief Shafiqul Islam, the arrests took place on Sunday night.

A DB official stated that the arrests followed the discovery of evidence linking them to a suspect in a case under the Anti-Terrorism Act and the Cyber Security Act.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #Army #Police #News

Source: bdnews24.com, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
